description: This file implements the core logic for managing voice and speech interactions within an iOS app, including speech recognition, TTS (Text-to-Speech) synthesis, microphone handling, push-to-talk functionality, incremental speech streaming, and interactions with a chat gateway. It centralizes the state and behavior related to 'Talk Mode' in the application.

classes.name: StreamFailureBox
classes.description: A thread-safe container for capturing stream failure errors, allowing for monitoring and fallback logic when streaming TTS data.

classes.name: TalkModeManager
classes.description: Main class managing voice input/output, speech recognition, chat interactions, and incremental speech streaming in the app.

methods.name: attachGateway
methods.description: Associates a gateway session for chat message exchange.

methods.name: updateGatewayConnected
methods.description: Updates the connection status with the gateway and manages recognition state accordingly.

methods.name: updateMainSessionKey
methods.description: Sets and updates the current chat session key, subscribing to relevant events.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables Talk Mode and manages associated resources.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins speech recognition, mic capture, and chat session, handling permissions and session configuration.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all speech recognition, mic capture, and chat interactions, releasing resources.

methods.name: suspendForBackground
methods.description: Temporarily suspends microphone input without fully disabling Talk Mode, e.g., when app backgrounds.

methods.name: resumeAfterBackground
methods.description: Resumes speech input after background suspension if appropriate.

methods.name: userTappedOrb
methods.description: Handles user interaction with the UI orb, specifically interrupting ongoing speech output.

methods.name: beginPushToTalk
methods.description: Starts a push-to-talk session, requesting microphone/speech permissions and setting recognition state.

methods.name: endPushToTalk
methods.description: Ends a PTT session, finalizing the transcript and potentially triggering chat processing.

methods.name: runPushToTalkOnce
methods.description: Performs a single push-to-talk exchange with a max duration.

methods.name: cancelPushToTalk
methods.description: Cancels ongoing PTT, resets state, and if needed resumes recognition.

methods.name: startRecognition
methods.description: Configures and starts speech recognition engine and request, with tap-based input processing.

methods.name: restartRecognitionAfterError
methods.description: Attempts to restart speech recognition after transient errors, during continuous listening.

methods.name: stopRecognition
methods.description: Stops active recognition tasks and removes taps.

methods.name: handleTranscript
methods.description: Processes recognized speech partials and final transcripts, managing recognition flow.

methods.name: startSilenceMonitor
methods.description: Begins monitoring silence to auto-trigger transcript processing.

methods.name: checkSilence
methods.description: Checks if silence periods should trigger transcript processing.

methods.name: schedulePTTTimeout
methods.description: Schedules timeout for push-to-talk auto-stop.

methods.name: handlePTTTimeout
methods.description: Handles timeout trigger for ongoing PTT sessions.

methods.name: finishPTTOnce
methods.description: Resumes the push-to-talk continuation after completion.

methods.name: processTranscript
methods.description: Handles sending the final transcript to the chat gateway and manages reply retrieval.

methods.name: subscribeChatIfNeeded
methods.description: Subscribes to chat events for a session key if not already subscribed.

methods.name: unsubscribeAllChats
methods.description: Unsubscribes from all chat sessions.

methods.name: buildPrompt
methods.description: Builds a prompt string from the transcript to send to the chat model.

methods.name: sendChat
methods.description: Sends the user message to the chat gateway and retrieves a runID.

methods.name: waitForChatCompletion
methods.description: Await chat completion or timeout, returning the final chat status.

methods.name: waitForAssistantText
methods.description: Polls for the latest assistant reply since a timestamp.

methods.name: fetchLatestAssistantText
methods.description: Fetches latest assistant message content from the chat history.

methods.name: playAssistant
methods.description: Speaks the assistant's reply, parsing directives and handling voice synthesis via ElevenLabs or fallback.

methods.name: stopSpeaking
methods.description: Immediately stops any ongoing speech output and resets speech state.

methods.name: shouldInterrupt
methods.description: Determines whether the current recognized speech should interrupt ongoing speech output.

methods.name: applyDirective
methods.description: Applies voice, model, or output directives to modify subsequent speech synthesis.

methods.name: resetIncrementalSpeech
methods.description: Clears incremental speech buffers and tasks to prepare for new speech output.

methods.name: cancelIncrementalSpeech
methods.description: Cancels ongoing incremental speech tasks.

methods.name: enqueueIncrementalSpeech
methods.description: Adds text segments to incremental speech queue.

methods.name: startIncrementalSpeechTask
methods.description: Begins background task to process and speak queued incremental speech segments.

methods.name: cancelIncrementalPrefetch
methods.description: Cancels prefetching of incremental speech audio chunks.

methods.name: cancelIncrementalPrefetchMonitor
methods.description: Cancels the monitoring task for upcoming incremental prefetches.

methods.name: startIncrementalPrefetchMonitor
methods.description: Starts monitoring for incremental prefetching of upcoming speech segments.

methods.name: ensureIncrementalPrefetchForUpcomingSegment
methods.description: Checks/starts prefetching for the next speech segment if appropriate.

methods.name: startIncrementalPreFetch
methods.description: Begins prefetching audio chunks for a speech segment using ElevenLabs API.

methods.name: completeIncrementalPrefetch
methods.description: Marks prefetch as complete with audio chunks.

methods.name: clearIncrementalPrefetch
methods.description: Clears prefetch data for an audio segment.

methods.name: failIncrementalPrefetch
methods.description: Handles failure in prefetching, cancels task.

methods.name: consumeIncrementalPrefetchedAudioIfAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves prefetched audio if available, otherwise waits for prefetch completion.

methods.name: resolveIncrementalPrefetchOutputFormat
methods.description: Determines appropriate output format (MP3 or PCM) for prefetching based on context.

methods.name: finishIncrementalSpeech
methods.description: Completes current incremental speech, flushing buffer and ending speech output.

methods.name: handleIncrementalAssistantFinal
methods.description: Processes final assistant reply, applies directives, and triggers speech playback.

methods.name: streamAssistant
methods.description: Streams assistant's incremental speech content from the server and queues for playback.

methods.name: updateIncrementalContextIfNeeded
methods.description: Ensures the incremental speech context reflects the current directives.
